in_marathi.name: Bal
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘vāl’, meaning protector or mighty. In Hindu mythology, Bal represents the embodiment of strength and power, often associated with gods like Hanuman and Bhagiratha.
